text: The Sparrow shows how flexible this is. Fired from a jet, it's the A I M seven. Fired from a ship, it becomes the R I M seven Sea Sparrow. Same number, new first letter.
And an R G M eighty-four D Harpoon reads the same way. Ship-launched. Surface attack. Guided missile. Design eighty-four. Fourth modification.
Now, a longer aircraft name: the H H sixty G.

The first H is the modified mission: search and rescue. The second H is the vehicle type: helicopter. Sixty is the design number, the same family as the U H sixty Black Hawk. And G is the series letter.
In fact, some of them started life as Black Hawks that were modified for rescue, and the mission letter followed the new job.
